newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hongkong Bank cuts NZ floating, fixed mtg rates.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank cuts NZ floating, fixed mtg rates.

text.p: Hongkong Bank said on Thursday it had cut its New Zealand floating mortgage rate to 8.4 percent from 8.95 percent, effective immediately for new business and from May 22 for existing customers.
The bank also said it cut its one-year fixed home lending rate to 8.5 percent from 8.95 percent.
The bank's two year fixed rate drops to 9.25 percent from 9.5 percent, and its three year fixed rate falls to 9.35 percent from 9.5 percent.
Hongkong Bank manager of personal banking Alex Bentley said the reductions were in line with the continued fall in wholesale interest rates.
